recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-39104 unless a later build artifact stops reflecting the active StructureDefinition source.
issue_request: FHIR-39104 was a Published R5 FHIR-core/List change request resolved Persuasive. It asked to remove the limited set of allowed List.subject target resource types so lists, including electronic Product Information examples, can use subjects such as MedicinalProductDefinition. The approved resolution was to relax List.subject to Reference(Any).
initial_application: Commit 01bb40dae88dfff0a9373fbd0e2b69d927a3b090 applied the issue by replacing the explicit Patient, Group, Device, Location, Organization, and Practitioner targetProfile values on List.subject with http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Resource.
additional_context: FHIR-39105 later changed the same List.subject element cardinality and usage note for the same broader ePI/multiple-subject use case. FHIR Infrastructure minutes from 2022-11-14 record the FHIR-39104 decision as 'Will remove the restriction on List.subject' with a Persuasive 11-0-2 motion. Direct Zulip searches found no FHIR-39104 references.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current combined source has List active in source/fhir.ini and List.subject is a Reference with targetProfile Resource, which is the core StructureDefinition representation of Reference(Any).
